depiction.primary_object: bold uppercase block letters spelling ATM
depiction.composition: three horizontal sans-serif characters centered in frame

readings.meaning: automated teller machine (ATM) or cash machine

ambiguity: Purely typographic acronym rather than a pictorial symbol; unreadable as a cash machine in languages that do not use the English abbreviation ATM, and at very small sizes the blocky letters can blur into a generic dark bar.
task_intents: deposit cash or checks at ATM

reasoning: The icon consists solely of the three letters 'ATM' with no pictorial element. While English speakers recognize it as an automated teller machine for cash withdrawals and deposits, it violates the pictorial-only rule (letters/digits only) and fails across languages that use different words for cash machines.
